examples.en: Disenchantment spread among the volunteers.
examples.cn: 幻灭情绪在志愿者中蔓延。

examples.en: He spoke of his disenchantment with the job.
examples.cn: 他谈起自己对这份工作的失望。

examples.en: Years of failure bred a quiet disenchantment.
examples.cn: 多年的失败滋生出一种沉默的醒悟。

dict_mnemonic.text: disenchantment ＝ dis-（去掉）＋ enchantment（着迷、魔法）＝魔法被解除；enchant 来自拉丁语 incantare「对着唱咒语」（in- ＋ cantare「唱」，与 chant 同根）＝咒语唱完发现只是木架，「幻灭、醒悟」。

root: 拉丁语 cantare（唱）→ incantare（唱咒语）→ 古法语 enchanter → 英语 enchant → enchantment → 加 dis- 成 disenchantment

sensesIntro.en: The spell wears off: bare frames behind a set, a badge in a drawer and a wand that is only a stick.
sensesIntro.cn: 魔法失效：布景后的裸木架、抽屉里的徽章与只是一根木棍的魔法棒。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stage lights coming up to show the wooden frame and wires behind a painted set
core.cn: 核心意象：舞台灯全亮，露出彩绘布景后面的木架与电线

branches.en: Voters seeing the frame behind the political set.
branches.cn: 选民看见政治布景后面的木架。

branches.en: A supporter dropping the badge in a drawer.
branches.cn: 支持者把徽章丢进抽屉。

branches.en: An insider holding a wand that is a plain stick.
branches.cn: 内部人手里那根只是木棍的魔法棒。

branches.en: Both end a belief that once felt warm.
branches.cn: 两者都终结了曾经热烈的相信。

branches.en: Both leave a sober view instead of a dream.
branches.cn: 两者都留下清醒的看法而不是梦。

intro.en: Disenchantment is dis- plus enchantment; the sing root also builds chant, incantation and cantor.
intro.cn: disenchantment 由 dis- 加 enchantment 构成；唱这个词根也造出 chant、incantation 与 cantor。

latinIntro.en: Latin cantare means to sing, incantare to chant a spell, and Greek kynikos dog like, the source of cynic.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cantare 意为唱，incantare 意为唱咒语，希腊语 kynikos 意为像狗的，是 cynic 的来源。

definition_zh: v. 使变丑；使毁容；损伤…的外观
definition_en: to spoil the appearance of someone or something
core_image: 一张平整的海报被人划了一道长口子；雕像的脸被凿掉一块，剩下的轮廓还在
scene: 涂鸦毁坏了整面墙的外观。Graffiti disfigured the whole wall.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：涂鸦让整面墙的外观受损。

pos.zh: 使变丑；使毁容；损伤外观

senses.title: Spoil a face or body
senses.definition: to damage the appearance of the face or body of a person
senses.definitionCN: （动词）损伤人的脸部或身体的外观
senses.example: The fire disfigured his hands.
senses.exampleCN: 那场火毁损了他双手的外观。
senses.why: A statue with a piece chipped from its face.
senses.whyCN: 一尊雕像的脸被凿掉一块。

senses.title: Spoil a thing or place
senses.definition: to make an object or place look ugly or damaged
senses.definitionCN: （动词）让物体或地方显得难看或受损
senses.example: Graffiti disfigured the whole wall.
senses.exampleCN: 涂鸦毁坏了整面墙的外观。
senses.why: A long tear across a smooth poster.
senses.whyCN: 一张平整海报上的一道长口子。

senses.title: Leave a lasting mark
senses.definition: to mark something in a way that does not go away
senses.definitionCN: （动词）以不会消失的方式在某物上留下痕迹
senses.example: The quarry disfigured the hillside for good.
senses.exampleCN: 采石场永久地损毁了山坡的外观。
senses.why: A bare scar cut across a green hillside.
senses.whyCN: 一道裸露的疤痕横切过绿色山坡。

intro.en: Disfigure is dis- plus figure; figure comes from Old French figure, from Latin figura, form or shape, from fingere, to shape or mould, the root behind fiction and feign.
intro.cn: disfigure 由 dis-（破坏）加 figure（外形、容貌）构成；figure 来自古法语 figure，上溯拉丁语 figura「形状」，来自 fingere「塑造」，也是 fiction 与 feign 的词根。

items.en: Latin fingere means to shape or mould.
items.cn: 拉丁语 fingere 意为塑造、捏制。

items.en: Figura meant form, shape or outward appearance.
items.cn: figura 意为形状、外形或外观。

items.en: Old French figure carried the sense of shape and face.
items.cn: 古法语 figure 带有形状与面貌的意思。

items.en: Figure entered English for shape and for a number symbol.
items.cn: figure 进入英语，表示形状，也表示数字符号。

items.en: Dis- gave disfigure, to spoil the shape.
items.cn: dis- 造出 disfigure，意为破坏外形。

items.en: The word is used for faces, buildings and landscapes.
items.cn: 这个词用于脸部、建筑与景观。

note.en: Disfigure is figure with the shape spoiled; its neighbours share the shape root or mean damaging a surface.
note.cn: disfigure 是把外形破坏掉的 figure；它的邻居要么同「形状」词根，要么指损伤表面。

entries.definition: a shape, a number symbol, or a person of note
entries.definitionCN: 形状、数字符号或知名人物

entries.definition: a damaged appearance, or the mark that causes it
entries.definitionCN: 受损的外观，或造成它的痕迹

entries.definition: using words in a non literal, pictured way
entries.definitionCN: 以非字面、形象化方式使用词语的

entries.definition: to damage the surface or appearance of something
entries.definitionCN: 损坏某物的表面或外观

entries.definition: to spoil the appearance or quality of something
entries.definitionCN: 损害某物的外观或品质

entries.definition: to damage something severely by cutting or breaking parts
entries.definitionCN: 通过切除或折断部分来严重损坏某物

normalIntro.en: Five pictures of a shape being spoiled.
normalIntro.cn: 五个外形被破坏的画面。

normal.en: A statue with a piece chipped from its face.
normal.cn: 一尊雕像的脸被凿掉一块。

normal.en: A long tear across a smooth poster.
normal.cn: 一张平整海报上的一道长口子。

normal.en: A bare scar cut across a green hillside.
normal.cn: 一道裸露的疤痕横切过绿色山坡。

normal.en: A painted door scored by a key.
normal.cn: 一扇漆门被钥匙划出痕迹。

normal.en: A billboard bolted across an old stone front.
normal.cn: 一块广告牌钉在老石墙门面上。

abstract.en: A statue with a piece chipped from its face.
abstract.cn: 一尊雕像的脸被凿掉一块。

abstract.en: A long tear across a smooth poster.
abstract.cn: 一张平整海报上的一道长口子。

abstract.en: A bare scar cut across a green hillside.
abstract.cn: 一道裸露的疤痕横切过绿色山坡。

examples.en: The accident disfigured her cheek.
examples.cn: 那次事故毁损了她脸颊的外观。

examples.en: Billboards disfigure the old street.
examples.cn: 广告牌破坏了老街的外观。

examples.en: He was left disfigured by the burns.
examples.cn: 烧伤让他留下了毁容的痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: disfigure ＝ dis-（破坏、去掉）＋ figure（外形、容貌，拉丁语 figura「形状」，来自 fingere「塑造」，与 fiction、feign 同根）＝把塑好的外形破坏掉，「使毁容、损伤外观」。

root: 拉丁语 fingere（塑造）→ figura（形状）→ 古法语 figure → 英语 figure → 加 dis- 成 disfigure

sensesIntro.en: A shape spoiled: a chipped statue face, a torn poster and a scar across a hillside.
sensesIntro.cn: 被破坏的外形：凿缺的雕像脸、撕开的海报与横切山坡的疤痕。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long tear across a smooth poster beside a statue with a piece chipped from its face
core.cn: 核心意象：平整海报上的一道长口子，旁边是一尊脸被凿缺的雕像

branches.en: A piece chipped from the face of a statue.
branches.cn: 被凿掉一块的雕像脸。

branches.en: A smooth poster torn by graffiti.
branches.cn: 被涂鸦撕开的平整海报。

branches.en: A bare scar across a green hillside.
branches.cn: 横切绿色山坡的裸露疤痕。

branches.en: Both spoil a surface people look at.
branches.cn: 两者都破坏了人们观看的表面。

branches.en: Both leave marks that stay for years.
branches.cn: 两者都留下多年不消的痕迹。

intro.en: Disfigure is dis- plus figure; the shape root also builds figurative, configuration and fiction.
intro.cn: disfigure 由 dis- 加 figure 构成；形状这个词根也造出 figurative、configuration 与 fiction。

latinIntro.en: Latin fingere means to shape, figura form or shape, and facies face or appearance.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fingere 意为塑造，figura 意为形状，facies 意为面貌。

definition_zh: n. 不一致；不和谐；不协调
definition_en: a lack of agreement or harmony between people, things or sounds
core_image: 合唱团里一个人唱跑了调，指挥的手停在半空；齿轮组里有一个齿对不上，整台机器卡住
scene: 色彩之间的不协调让房间显得杂乱。The disharmony of the colours made the room feel messy.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：颜色彼此不搭，整个房间显得杂乱。

senses.title: Lack of agreement between people
senses.definition: a lack of agreement or friendly feeling between people or groups
senses.definitionCN: （名词）人或群体之间缺乏一致或友好感情
senses.example: Disharmony between the two groups slowed the work.
senses.exampleCN: 两个群体之间的不和拖慢了工作。
senses.why: A conductor with a hand frozen while one singer is off key.
senses.whyCN: 指挥的手停在半空，因为有一个歌手唱跑了调。

senses.title: Things that do not fit
senses.definition: a failure of parts, colours or elements to fit together well
senses.definitionCN: （名词）部件、颜色或元素彼此搭配不好
senses.example: The disharmony of the colours made the room feel messy.
senses.exampleCN: 色彩之间的不协调让房间显得杂乱。
senses.why: A gear whose teeth will not meet the next wheel.
senses.whyCN: 一个齿轮的齿咬不上旁边的轮子。

senses.title: Sounds that clash
senses.definition: a lack of harmony in music or sound
senses.definitionCN: （名词）音乐或声音中缺乏和谐
senses.example: The disharmony in the final chord was deliberate.
senses.exampleCN: 最后那个和弦的不和谐是刻意为之。
senses.why: Two strings tuned a little apart on one guitar.
senses.whyCN: 同一把吉他上两根音调得略微错开的弦。

intro.en: Disharmony is dis- plus harmony; harmony comes from Greek harmonia, a fitting together, from harmos, a joint, so disharmony means joints that do not meet.
intro.cn: disharmony 由 dis-（否定）加 harmony（和谐）构成；harmony 来自希腊语 harmonia「接合在一起」，来自 harmos「接缝」，所以 disharmony 就是接缝对不上。

items.en: Greek harmos means a joint or fitting.
items.cn: 希腊语 harmos 意为接缝、接合。

items.en: Harmonia meant a fitting together, then agreement.
items.cn: harmonia 意为接合在一起，后来指一致。

items.en: Latin harmonia carried the musical sense of concord.
items.cn: 拉丁语 harmonia 带有音乐上协和的意思。

items.en: Old French harmonie entered for agreement of parts.
items.cn: 古法语 harmonie 表示各部分的一致。

items.en: Middle English armony became harmony.
items.cn: 中古英语 armony 变成 harmony。

items.en: Dis- gave disharmony, a lack of harmony.
items.cn: dis- 造出 disharmony，意为缺乏和谐。

note.en: Disharmony is harmony with the joints apart; its neighbours share the joint root or name a clash.
note.cn: disharmony 是接缝分开的 harmony；它的邻居要么同「接合」词根，要么指冲突。

entries.definition: agreement of parts, or pleasing combined sounds
entries.definitionCN: 各部分的一致，或悦耳的组合音

entries.definition: fitting together well; friendly and agreeing
entries.definitionCN: 搭配得当的；友好而一致的

entries.definition: not fitting together; lacking harmony
entries.definitionCN: 搭配不上的；缺乏和谐的

entries.definition: disagreement between people, or harsh combined sounds
entries.definitionCN: 人际不和，或刺耳的组合音

entries.definition: a serious disagreement or struggle between aims
entries.definitionCN: 目标之间严重的分歧或争斗

entries.definition: a situation where parts are not equal or balanced
entries.definitionCN: 各部分不相等或不平衡的状况

normalIntro.en: Five pictures of joints that will not meet.
normalIntro.cn: 五个接缝对不上的画面。

normal.en: A conductor with a hand frozen while one singer is off key.
normal.cn: 指挥的手停在半空，因为有一个歌手唱跑了调。

normal.en: A gear whose teeth will not meet the next wheel.
normal.cn: 一个齿轮的齿咬不上旁边的轮子。

normal.en: Two strings tuned a little apart on one guitar.
normal.cn: 同一把吉他上两根音调得略微错开的弦。

normal.en: A red cushion dropped onto a pale green sofa.
normal.cn: 一个红靠垫扔在浅绿沙发上。

normal.en: Two puzzle pieces pressed together that refuse to join.
normal.cn: 两块按在一起却拼不上的拼图。

abstract.en: A conductor with a hand frozen while one singer is off key.
abstract.cn: 指挥的手停在半空，因为有一个歌手唱跑了调。

abstract.en: A gear whose teeth will not meet the next wheel.
abstract.cn: 一个齿轮的齿咬不上旁边的轮子。

abstract.en: Two strings tuned a little apart on one guitar.
abstract.cn: 同一把吉他上两根音调得略微错开的弦。

examples.en: Disharmony in the team delayed the launch.
examples.cn: 团队内部的不协调推迟了发布。

examples.en: The disharmony of the two styles is obvious.
examples.cn: 两种风格之间的不协调显而易见。

examples.en: He played the chord to show disharmony.
examples.cn: 他弹那个和弦是为了展示不和谐。

dict_mnemonic.text: disharmony ＝ dis-（否定）＋ harmony（和谐，希腊语 harmonia「接合」，来自 harmos「接缝」）＝接缝对不上，「不和谐、不一致」；同根还有 harmonious（和谐的）、harmonize（使协调）。

root: 希腊语 harmos（接缝）→ harmonia（接合、一致）→ 拉丁语 harmonia → 古法语 harmonie → 英语 harmony → 加 dis- 成 disharmony

sensesIntro.en: Joints that will not meet: an off key singer, a gear that will not mesh and two strings tuned apart.
sensesIntro.cn: 对不上的接缝：跑调的歌手、咬合不上的齿轮与两根调错的弦。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gear whose teeth will not meet the next wheel while the hand of a conductor freezes in the air
core.cn: 核心意象：一个齿轮的齿咬不上旁边的轮子，同时指挥的手停在半空

branches.en: Two groups whose aims will not join.
branches.cn: 目标接不上的两个群体。

branches.en: Colours and gears that refuse to fit.
branches.cn: 彼此不搭的颜色与齿轮。

branches.en: Two strings tuned a little apart.
branches.cn: 音调略微错开的两根弦。

branches.en: Both are parts that should fit but do not.
branches.cn: 两者都是本该契合却契合不上的部分。

branches.en: Both produce a clash you can sense at once.
branches.cn: 两者都产生立刻能感到的冲突。

intro.en: Disharmony is dis- plus harmony; the joint root also builds harmonious, harmonize and harmony itself.
intro.cn: disharmony 由 dis- 加 harmony 构成；接合这个词根也造出 harmonious、harmonize 与 harmony 本身。

latinIntro.en: Greek harmos means a joint, harmonia a fitting together, and Latin libra a balance.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 harmos 意为接缝，harmonia 意为接合，拉丁语 libra 意为天平。

definition_zh: 不诚实的；欺骗性的
definition_en: not telling the truth, or intended to deceive people
core_image: 一只手把抽屉关到一半，另一只手还藏在背后
scene: 抽屉被推到一半就停住，另一只手始终没拿出来。It was dishonest of him to keep the money.
sceneCN: 这里 dishonest 指「不诚实的」（第 1 个义项：说话或行事不老实）；句意是他把那笔钱留下是不诚实的。

senses.title: Not telling the truth
senses.definition: saying or doing something that is not true
senses.definitionCN: 说了或做了不真实的事
senses.example: He gave a dishonest answer.
senses.exampleCN: 他给了一个不老实的回答。
senses.why: A half-closed drawer is its own kind of sentence.
senses.whyCN: 半关的抽屉本身就是一句话。

senses.title: Built to deceive
senses.definition: made or done in order to trick people
senses.definitionCN: 为欺骗别人而做成或做出的
senses.example: The ad used dishonest numbers.
senses.exampleCN: 那则广告用了骗人的数字。
senses.why: A number can lie as easily as a mouth.
senses.whyCN: 数字撒起谎来和嘴一样容易。

intro.en: Dishonest is dis- plus honest, from Latin honestus, honourable, which rests on honos, honour.
intro.cn: dishonest 是 dis- 加 honest；honest 来自拉丁语 honestus（可敬的），其根是 honos（荣誉）。

items.en: Honos meant honour and public respect.
items.cn: honos 指荣誉与公众的敬重。

items.en: Honestus meant honourable and decent.
items.cn: honestus 意为体面的、可敬的。

items.en: Honest entered English as honourable.
items.cn: honest 进入英语时意为可敬的。

items.en: Dis- reversed it into the lacking of honour.
items.cn: 前缀 dis- 把它翻成缺少荣誉。

items.en: Dishonest now covers lies, tricks and cheating.
items.cn: 今天 dishonest 涵盖说谎、欺骗与作弊。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the honest stem, and the meaning group names other words for a lie.
note.cn: 形近组共享 honest 词干，近义组列出别的说谎之词。

entries.definition: truthful and fair
entries.definitionCN: 诚实而公正的

entries.definition: the quality of being truthful
entries.definitionCN: 诚实的品质

entries.definition: the practice of telling lies
entries.definitionCN: 说谎的做法

entries.definition: using lies to get what you want
entries.definitionCN: 用谎言达成目的

entries.definition: saying things that are not true
entries.definitionCN: 说不是真的话

entries.definition: dishonest in business or politics
entries.definitionCN: 生意或政治上的不老实

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a half-shut drawer and end with a trust worn thin.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从半关的抽屉开始，落到一层被磨薄的信任。

normal.en: Dis- plus honest: honour taken away.
normal.cn: dis 加 honest，把可敬拿走。

normal.en: A dishonest shop keeps one bad scale.
normal.cn: 不诚实的店，总会有一杆坏秤。

normal.en: A dishonest answer often arrives too quickly.
normal.cn: 不老实的回答，往往来得太快。

normal.en: One dishonest line can spoil a long report.
normal.cn: 一行不实的话，能毁掉一份长报告。

normal.en: Dishonest money is the most expensive kind.
normal.cn: 不义之财是最贵的一种钱。

abstract.en: Picture a drawer pushed half shut and held.
abstract.cn: 想象抽屉被推到一半又停住。

abstract.en: Picture a hand kept behind the back.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手始终藏在背后。

abstract.en: Picture a scale that leans by a hair.
abstract.cn: 想象一杆秤只偏了一点点。

examples.en: It was dishonest of him to keep the money.
examples.cn: 他把那笔钱留下是不诚实的。

examples.en: She refused to sign a dishonest report.
examples.cn: 她拒绝在一份不实的报告上签字。

examples.en: Dishonest traders were banned from the market.
examples.cn: 不诚实的商贩被禁止进入市场。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 dishonest 记成「去掉可敬」：dis 是否定，词根 honest 意为可敬、老实，去掉这一层就是不诚实。

root: 由否定前缀 dis- 加 honest 构成；honest 源自拉丁语 honestus（可敬的），其根 honos 指荣誉与敬重。因此 dishonest 的字面意思是「失去可敬」，英语里用来指说话不实、行事取巧或以骗术待人。

sensesIntro.en: From the plain absence of honour to the habit of bending facts.
sensesIntro.cn: 从荣誉的缺席，到把事实扳弯的习惯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drawer pushed half shut, with one hand still behind the back.
core.cn: 核心意象：抽屉被推到一半，一只手还藏在背后。

branches.en: The first sense is the person who does not tell the truth.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是不肯说实话的人。

branches.en: The second sense is the thing made to trick you.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是被做出来骗你的东西。

branches.en: Both senses work by leaving something out.
branches.cn: 两个义项都靠藏起某样东西起作用。

branches.en: Both cost more trust than they gain.
branches.cn: 两个义项花掉的信任都比赚到的多。

branches.en: Only the second sense can be printed in an ad.
branches.cn: 只有第二个义项能印在广告里。

intro.en: Dishonest is the negative of honest, in the Latin honos family of honour and respect.
intro.cn: dishonest 是 honest 的反面，属于拉丁语 honos（荣誉与敬重）一族。

latinIntro.en: Latin honos gives honestus and then honest, and the prefix dis- removes the honour again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 honos 给出 honestus，再成为 honest，前缀 dis- 又把这份荣誉拿走。

items.example: A dishonest claim was struck out.
items.exampleCN: 一项不实的说法被删去了。

items.example: He spoke honestly about the fault.

items.exampleCN: 不诚实断送了他的职业。
